description: Published Doench 2016 CFD aggregate guide specificity score following CRISPOR annotateOfftargets (main PAM by default; include_alternative_pams reproduces its wider NAG/NGA search): 100/(100 + sum of raw per-hit CFD) * 100 (MitStyle), or the doCfdFix variant 100 / sum (ParkinsonNormalized).

guide_sequence.description: Guide RNA sequence (must be 20 nt for the supported systems).

max_mismatches.description: Maximum allowed mismatches (range 0..5; default 4, the reference's default).

system_type.description: CRISPR system (default SpCas9); must be a 20-nt PAM-after-target system.

aggregation.description: Which published aggregation to use (default MitStyle, the reference's default).

include_alternative_pams.description: Also scan the reference's alternative PAMs for this system (default false = main PAM only): SpCas9 adds NAG and NGA; NGA adds NGG. Every hit is scored by its own PAM with the CFD matrices, no 0.2 factor (that factor is applied by the reference to the MIT score only).

min_alternative_pam_hit_score.description: Only with include_alternative_pams: minimum MIT/Hsu hit score (0..100) an alternative-PAM hit needs to count — the reference's ALTPAMMINSCORE / --minAltPamScore, tested on the MIT hit score even for the CFD aggregate. Default 1.0, the reference's own default; 0 = no filtering.

on_target_start.description: Optional on-target interval start (0-based, inclusive, forward-strand coordinates of the genome string; give both on_target_start and on_target_end or neither). Exact (0-mismatch) matches whose protospacer+PAM footprint lies inside [on_target_start, on_target_end) are skipped as the on-target - CRISPOR's annotateOfftargets skip - and every other perfect match is scored as an off-target (hit score 100). Default (omitted): the first exact match in scan order is the on-target (CRISPOR's auto-ontarget mode) and every further perfect match is scored.

on_target_end.description: Optional on-target interval end (0-based, exclusive); see on_target_start.

max_occurrences.description: Genomic-occurrence limit of a repeat guide (default 60000, CRISPOR's MAXOCC): a guide with more alignments than this - windows of the guide's length, either strand, any PAM, within max_mismatches substitutions - is suppressed and scores 0 under either aggregation.

specificity.description: Aggregate CFD specificity (0..100 for MitStyle; unbounded for ParkinsonNormalized).

errors.message: Guide sequence cannot be null or empty
Genome cannot be null or empty
Maximum mismatches must be in the range 0..5
Guide length does not match the system's guide length
The CFD model is defined only for a 20-nt protospacer (SaCas9 / Cas12a-class / CasX are refused)
The ParkinsonNormalized CFD aggregate is undefined for a CFD sum of 0
The CFD aggregation must be a defined CfdAggregation value (checked before the repeat-guide rule can return 0)
